title: Kata Brushkeep
tagline: Make space for your next world.
description: An original browser blockout editor inspired by TrenchBroom. Build a small world from solid brushes, shape it in 3D and plan views, and save the idea for its next chapter.
verificationEvidence: Initial release commit 217960e3482491ed663442a5d520812e6448cb56 passed syntax/build checks and Pages deployment at https://github.com/intrepion/kata-app-inspired-by-trenchbroom-codex-dot/actions/runs/42792631680. On 2026-11-10, all ten deployed assets returned HTTP 200 and exactly matched the tested dist bytes. 65 local browser-served tests passed. Native checks covered draw/move/orbit/undo, autosave, JSON download/reopen and OBJ/MAP downloads. MAP remains unverified in TrenchBroom and game engines.
features: Six materials and precise geometry inspector
Editable JSON projects and browser autosave
projectNotes: Original independent learning project inspired by TrenchBroom, not an official product or feature-complete substitute.
Axis-aligned cuboid brushes only. No CSG, arbitrary vertex editing, texture imports, collision, engine preview, or map compiler.

Brushkeep JSON is the only editable import format. OBJ exports untextured Z-up geometry. MAP export is experimental, uses placeholder textures, and has not been verified in TrenchBroom or a game engine.
Browser autosave is not a backup. Save a JSON project for safekeeping.
